sources.title: Qingqiu Agent（A self-developed spreadsheet AI engine launched by ...
sources.snippet: Qingqiu Agent is a self-developed spreadsheet AI engine launched by Kingsoft Office on April 22, 2026, at the WPS AI NEXT Wuhan event. As the AI engine for WPS Multi-dimensional Tables, it supports the direct generation of table structures, views, and dashboards through natural language descriptions, and provides AI capabilities in data processing and analysis.
